verdict.rationale: Adyen offers documented agent-usable surfaces: an official MCP server for natural-language access to the platform, an llms.txt index, and markdown docs. The underlying money-side primitives are also documented: balance accounts via the Configuration API, managed and custom payouts, webhooks for status changes, and chargeback defense document uploads. However, nothing shows the MCP server covers balances, payouts or disputes, and the payout-investigation and dispute-evidence flows are only implied by the general docs. Missing for 10: evidence the MCP server exposes balance/payout/dispute tools, a documented API path for tracing a missing payout (payout/transfer status lookup), detail on submitting dispute defense evidence via API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
